object_description: fragmented urban island around a wooded collective heart
design_condition: The proposal reinforces the site's perimeter with housing and a school while placing parking at the low point along the road, preserving a wooded collective heart and adapting built plateaus to the slope.

positive.statement: The urban-island concept creates a vast tree-filled collective heart and fragmented built fronts at the scale of the surrounding district.
The clearly positioned soft-mobility network anchors the project in a larger scope and creates a new green multifunctional centrality.
The school opens onto the park with a covered courtyard that facilitates management of the children.
The parking is skillfully inserted into the topography and its presence is reduced as much as possible.
The shallow building depth offers numerous typological potentials and high quality of use, particularly in terms of light.
The diversity of landscape environments results from the relationship between peripheral functions and building identities rather than being forced.
The proposal is a real sewing and valorization operation of the existing through landscape programs open to different uses and favourable to flora and fauna.
The project pays great attention to open-space quality by integrating open-air water-management systems.
The distribution of the program makes the different operators and programs independent, allowing great operational flexibility.
The school can be built in a first phase while maintaining much of the existing parking and plane trees.
The compact school opens onto the park with a covered courtyard that will probably become the main entrance.
Each level is organized around a generous central collective space with overhead and side light and a shared landing.
The distribution on either side of the central space offers great flexibility for classroom allocation.
The constructive concept is consistent, with a collective distributive core and classroom construction arranged around it.
The treatment of changing rooms and glazed doors shows great care and concern in the architectural devices.
Solar protection by roof overhangs and projections ensures the comfort of the schoolchildren.

negative.statement: The street entrance does not offer sufficient clearance and should not become the main entrance.
